title: Trump announces 50% tariff on Brazil - Main Stream Videos
text:
President Trump said he plans to impose a 50% tariff on goods made in Brazil starting August 1. He sent tariff letters to seven countries on Wednesday, including the Philippines, Brunei, Moldova, Algeria, Iraq, Libya and Sri Lanka. CBS News’ Olivia Rinaldi and Kelly O’Grady have the details.
